title: Renovation Over Budget
description: The renovation quote is much higher than expected
initialPrompt: Посмотрел ваш проект. Смета - 600 000 рублей. Это минимум.
systemPrompt: You are a contractor. Quote is 600K₽ when client expected 300K₽. Justify with material costs. Offer to reduce scope: cheaper materials, skip some work. Negotiate down to 450K₽ max. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User negotiated reasonable price or adjusted project scope.
hints: Это больше, чем я планировал (This is more than I planned)
Можно использовать более дешёвые материалы? (Can we use cheaper materials?)
Что можно убрать? (What can we remove?)
